summary: Alice entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Alice: Madness Returns
entries.definitive_edition: Alice: Madness Returns on Windows PC

emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Windows PC at current high settings

primary.why: Alice: Madness Returns is available on PC, and the Windows route has the best capture/settings ceiling. Console versions are useful historical routes, especially when preserving the 2011 console-era package context.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current Windows version on Steam or EA app. Record storefront, DLC/bonus-content state, controller or keyboard input, and any known configuration changes.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record storefront and DLC/bonus-content state. Do not merge American McGee's Alice into this sequel entry.

entries.title: American McGee's Alice
entries.definitive_edition: Original Windows PC release with compatibility fixes

emulation.notes: Use native PC compatibility fixes or period hardware/VM if needed.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Original PC release on compatible Windows setup

primary.version: Original PC release / preserved owned install
primary.why: American McGee's Alice is the original 2000 action-adventure, distinct from Alice: Madness Returns. The Windows version is the historical main route, while the later downloadable/bundled console access through Madness Returns should be treated as a preservation access path, not a replacement.
primary.how_to_play: Use an owned Windows PC copy with compatibility fixes as needed. Record disc/digital source, patch/fix state, resolution, input, and whether the Madness Returns bundled/downloadable version was compared.

secondary.exclusive_content: Later console access through Alice: Madness Returns package context
secondary.what_to_play: Use only if preserving the 2011 package/access route.
secondary.why: It is a useful access path but should not merge the original game into the sequel entry.

entries.remaster_caveats: Do not merge with Alice: Madness Returns. Record source and fixes because modern official access is limited.
